narration: For {identical_months} months the two lives ran as one. In month {fork_month}, you chose {real_choice} and the ghost took {ghost_choice}. At the layoff in month {layoff_month}, the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}. By month {end_month}, the ghost had {net_worth_gap}. More of the ghost's pay already had somewhere to go before each month began, and its Freedom ended {freedom_gap}. The ghost's days were a shade less of a grind, its Life {life_gap}.
